name: get_claim_status
description: Look up a single claim by its claim ID and return its current status, amounts, and (if denied) the denial reason code. Only claims belonging to the member on this call can be read.

name: search_claims_by_member
description: List all claims on file for the member on this call, most recent first. Takes no arguments - the member is bound from the authenticated session, not passed in.

name: get_appeal_info
description: For a denied claim, return whether it is eligible for appeal, the appeal deadline, and current appeal status. Only claims belonging to the member on this call can be read.

name: check_eligibility
description: Check the current enrollment status and plan of the member on this call, to confirm they are eligible for the claim being discussed. Takes no arguments - the member is bound from the authenticated session, not passed in.
